ambiguities_or_notes: Verse lineation is preserved, but rhyme is not mechanically recreated because doing so would require freer paraphrase.

The childlike ellipses in 'Что не дитя я молчаливый / Когда меня ласкала мать' and 'Которым день сей подарил' are rendered with the minimum English supplementation needed to make the relations intelligible.
The repeated 'еще раз ... опять' remains 'once again ... again' rather than being stylistically deduplicated.
